lines.text: If your bank covers every bill, payment is automatic. Otherwise, choose an affordable group to keep. All tier one pieces must stay. The review upkeep setting also lets you release bigger pieces voluntarily. Losing your last piece loses the game.

supplement.title: Pay before healing and Place
supplement.body:
Enough crystals: payment is automatic.
Otherwise choose an affordable group. All T1 must stay.
Review upkeep each turn: optionally release T2 or T3.
No pieces left means elimination.
